pr_title: #14255: Add metrics to track chunk allocations and deallocations
pr_body:
Motivation:

Added metrics to track chunk allocations and deallocations so allocation rate by the arena can be tracked.

Modification:

Added `numChunkAllocations`, `numChunkDeallocations`, `numActiveChunks` to `PoolArenaMetric`

Result:

Fixes #14255.

issue_context.title: Add metric to track chunk allocations
issue_context.body: I think it would be nice to have chunk allocations/deallocations metrics so we could detect inefficiencies of memory management strategies by continuous monitoring

review_comments: We could add a comment that all other `destroyChunk` calls comes from the arena itself being finalized, and so don't need to be counted.
